annotation.title_clean: Senate Bill No. 1134 - Relating to Aeronautics (Restrictions on Use of Unmanned Aircraft Systems)
annotation.title_en: Senate Bill No. 1134 - Relating to Aeronautics (Restrictions on Use of Unmanned Aircraft Systems)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Idaho Legislature, Senate State Affairs Committee
annotation.summary_en: Idaho Senate Bill 1134 (2013) adds Section 21-213 to the Idaho Code, restricting use of unmanned aircraft systems for surveillance or photography of individuals, homes and farms without written consent, and creating a civil cause of action with $1,000 liquidated damages plus attorney's fees.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines UAS as powered aerial vehicles flying autonomously or remotely, excluding recreational models and commercial photography
Bans warrantless UAS surveillance of persons, dwellings and farms without written consent absent reasonable suspicion of crime
Prohibits photographing individuals for publication without consent
Creates civil cause of action with $1,000 liquidated damages and attorney's fees
Exempts facility owners inspecting facilities on easements and marijuana eradication by law enforcement
